newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower on U.S. interest rate fears.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower on U.S. interest rate fears.

text.p: Leading UK shares finished the week sharply lower as renewed fears about a hike in U.S. interest rates after more strong U.S. economic data sent the market tumbling, traders said on Friday.

An unexpected jump to 60.0 in the Chicago Purchasing Managers index (PMI) and a stronger-than-forecast 1.8 percent rise in U.S. factory orders sparked a sell-off in bonds and sent the Dow spinning more than 50 points.
The UK market followed suit, the FTSE 100 -- which on Thursday had climbed to 3,8921.1, just below its record of 3,922.1 -- sliding 17.3 points to end at 3,867.7.
